Black Angus Menu: Satisfy Your Hunger with These Must-Try Dishes

The Black Angus Steakhouse is a renowned restaurant chain known for its delectable menu offerings, which include top-tier steaks, seafood, and a variety of other dishes that cater to every palate. Whether you’re a steak lover, seafood enthusiast, or someone who enjoys a hearty dinner, Black Angus has something to satisfy your hunger. In this comprehensive guide, we will delve into the Black Angus menu, exploring its diverse options, pricing, and much more. This informational content is crafted for those looking to explore the best menu deals and detailed knowledge of what’s available at Black Angus.

Menu Overview: A Journey of Flavor

The Black Angus menu offers a rich variety of choices, from classic steaks to seafood dishes, ensuring that every visit promises a satisfying experience. The Black Angus Steakhouse takes pride in its high-quality steak, which is expertly flame-grilled to perfection. From the tender Filet Mignon to the hearty Prime Rib, there’s something for everyone.

The Signature Steaks

The Black Angus restaurant specializes in Angus steaks, renowned for their rich flavor and tenderness. Each steak is aged at least 21 days, ensuring a juicy, tender bite with every cut. The Certified Angus Beef® is a standout on the menu, offering a high-quality steak that meets the strictest standards.

Steak Type Description Price
Filet Mignon A lean, tender cut of beef with a mild flavor. $25.99
Ribeye Marbled with fat for a rich, juicy flavor. $28.99
New York Strip Firm, flavorful, and a robust steak for the true steak lover. $27.99
Prime Rib Known for its tenderness and rich flavor, a classic Black Angus favorite. $24.99

Seafood Delights

For those who enjoy seafood, Black Angus doesn’t disappoint. The seafood section of the menu includes both fresh and grilled options. Whether you’re craving shrimp, salmon, or crab, each dish is prepared to perfection, ensuring a satisfying meal.

Seafood Dish Description Price
Grilled Salmon A tender, flaky piece of salmon grilled with your choice of seasoning. $21.99
Garlic Shrimp Shrimp sautéed in rich garlic butter, served with a side of potato. $19.99
Crab Cakes Delicately prepared with a blend of seasonings and served with sauce. $23.99

Salads and Sides: Complementing Your Meal

In addition to the main dishes, the Black Angus menu also offers a variety of salads and sides that are perfect for complementing your meal. From fresh avocado to hearty potatoes, there are plenty of options to suit your preferences.

Special Deals and Options

At Black Angus, there are also a range of specials and menu deals that allow you to enjoy a hearty meal at a great price. These options vary by location, but some popular choices include the Campfire Feast and Campfire Feast Dinner for Two.

Campfire Feast Dinner for Two

This special dinner package includes a variety of mouthwatering dishes, such as a choice of steak, shrimp, and a range of sides like baked potato and garlic bread. It’s a perfect option for couples or groups looking to enjoy a full meal together.

Campfire Feast for Two Description Price
Campfire Feast for Two A combination of Angus steaks, shrimp, potato, and garlic bread. $49.99

BBQ Options

Black Angus also serves BBQ dishes that are ideal for those craving smoky, grilled flavors. Whether it’s BBQ pork or a rack of ribs, these options are sure to satisfy.

BBQ Dish Description Price
BBQ Pork Ribs Smoky and tender pork ribs coated in a rich BBQ sauce. $18.99
BBQ Ribs (Half Rack) A half rack of BBQ ribs, perfect for those who prefer a smaller portion. $16.99

Grill and Other Entrees: Explore Even More Options

In addition to steaks and seafood, the Black Angus menu includes a variety of other delicious dishes. These range from sandwiches to grilled chicken and hearty burgers.

Grill Item Description Price
Grilled Chicken Chicken grilled to perfection, served with a side of potato or vegetables. $16.99
Angus Burger A juicy Angus beef patty with lettuce, tomato, and cheese. $13.99
Chicken Sandwich Tender chicken breast, grilled or crispy, served with fresh toppings. $12.99

Desserts and Drinks: Sweet Endings to Your Meal

No meal at Black Angus is complete without a delicious dessert or refreshing drink. Whether you’re in the mood for something light or indulgent, the dessert menu has you covered.

Dessert Description Price

Drink Description Price

Order Online and Delivery Options

For those who prefer to enjoy Black Angus from the comfort of their own home, you can order online and have your meal delivered directly to your door. Whether you’re craving a steak, seafood, or a classic burger, Black Angus offers delivery options that allow you to enjoy their signature dishes without leaving the house.

FAQs about Black Angus Menu

1. What kind of steaks does Black Angus offer?

Black Angus offers a variety of steaks, including Filet Mignon, Ribeye, Prime Rib, and the New York Strip. Each steak is carefully aged and cooked to perfection.

2. Does Black Angus have seafood options?

Yes, Black Angus offers several seafood options, such as grilled salmon, garlic shrimp, and crab cakes. These dishes are prepared with fresh ingredients to ensure quality and flavor.

3. What sides can I get with my steak?

Popular side dishes at Black Angus include baked potato, garlic-pepper zucchini, and Caesar salad. These sides pair wonderfully with the main dishes.

4. Are there any specials available at Black Angus?

Yes, Black Angus offers specials such as the Campfire Feast Dinner for Two and various BBQ options, including BBQ pork ribs and BBQ half-rack ribs.

5. Can I order online and get my food delivered?

Yes, Black Angus provides online ordering and delivery services for customers who prefer to enjoy their meal at home.
